description: Belgian calibration references (reference set calibration), generated by tools/generate_be_target_references.py from the pinned Chronicle be feed. Selectors only: no observation is carried. Demography targets Statbel's 1 January 2026 population directly; every other row rolls a 2023-2025 fact to 2026 by a declared FPB June 2026 ratio pair or stays parked with a named reason. Method-card choices are proposed pending d1902. Belgium stays inactive.

The stand-in is never described as reproducing official taxable income.

target_references.name: statbel_b4_declarations__joint

metadata.parking_reason: S1/S2-d: the declared tax-unit partition and the BE-MC4 legal-status proxy (partner pointers calibrated to these counts) are not built; joint and individual declaration indicators have no producer. B.4, like A.1, counts only declarations with positive total net taxable income (Statbel's 523,770 zero-income declarations of income year 2023 are outside it), so the indicators must count the same declared filing universe as the A.1 bands (d1952 build item 2), or the target overshoots by up to 7%.

B.4, like A.1, counts only declarations with positive total net taxable income (Statbel's 523,770 zero-income declarations of income year 2023 are outside it), so the indicators must count the same declared filing universe as the A.1 bands (d1952 build item 2), or the target overshoots by up to 7%.
